title: Phase C Sanitized Author-Facing Context Card Schema (Blinded)
description: Defines the blinded card format provided to independent authors. STRICT CONSTRAINT: Excludes partition, benchmark_id, provenance_tier, and repository identifiers.

problem_scenario.description: Realistic engineering situation in which a developer encounters the issue or task.

observable_behavior.description: Observed system failure, defect, or required functionality, expressed without naming implementation symbols or filenames.

expected_outcome.description: Expected correct behavior or system capability once resolved.

environmental_context.description: Relevant runtime or protocol context using neutral technical terminology.
